card.name: Alcohol content of liquid medicines
card.fires_on: Punctuation, numbers and small words right after an oral solution's label says it contains ethanol or alcohol, just before the amount or the next solvent such as propylene glycol.

modes.label: Amount after alcohol
modes.description: The bracket, percent sign or digits that give the alcohol strength in a solution.

modes.label: Start of next solvent
modes.description: The opening piece of propylene glycol listed after alcohol.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like prop, sol, vol and prot, as in propylene glycol, solvent and volume.
card.plain: It fires where a label states how much alcohol a liquid drug contains, or lists the next solvent.
